description: This dataset contains video recordings of siphonophores collected during the Birkeland Cruise, specifically focusing on marine biology observations. It includes metadata such as event identifiers, file references, and digital hashes to ensure data integrity and traceability. Each entry is geographically tagged with precise latitude and longitude coordinates, allowing researchers to map the spatial distribution of these organisms. The data also records the specific date of collection, facilitating temporal analysis of the sightings. This resource is valuable for studying siphonophore behavior, distribution patterns, and ecological interactions in their natural marine environment, supporting broader oceanographic and biological research initiatives.
